name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
purpose: Describe a focusable interface element with compact, non-interactive supplementary content on pointer hover or keyboard focus.
accessibility: The focusable trigger references the visible tooltip with aria-describedby.
Tooltip content never receives focus or pointer interaction.
Escape and blur dismiss the tooltip without changing trigger focus.
commonMistakes: Putting interactive controls inside a tooltip.
Using a tooltip as the only source of essential instructions.
Making touch access depend on hover alone.
